name: basement-char-b
comment: Candidate B, THE BUCKET HAT: the basement bull as an iconic character, comic silhouette, face half hidden. Front first, five more angles from it.
subject: Live-action documentary realism, a full-body character study for a film: shot on a full-frame cinema camera with a 50 mm lens, soft even golden-hour light in a dense pine forest with the low sun flaring between the trunks behind, the figure centred and fully in frame head to toe, natural skin and fabric, fine film grain, true-to-life colour. No text, no logos, no real or recognisable person: a designed character. THE CHARACTER, CANDIDATE B: a soft, round-shouldered twenty-two-year-old in a lime-green bucket hat pulled low over thick black-rimmed glasses, a washed-out grey hoodie with a cartoon-free plain front, a doomed attempt at a thin moustache, giant black over-ear headphones round his neck, baggy black cargo shorts, long white tube socks in black slides, a huge matte-black energy drink can with a plain green stripe (no logo, no words) and a phone in a glittery pink case.
